description_sq:
Splendor Residence eshte nje projekt ambicioz i vendosur ne zonen e Porcelanit, vetem pak metra nga rruga kryesore. Hapësira e brendshme e kompleksit të banimit, krijon mikro hapësirë të gjelbra, gjysmë-fusha basketbolli, kënde lojërash për fëmijë, 2 lulishte të gjelbëruara dhe hapësira rekreative rreth tyre.
Disponojme per shitje Apartament 2+1 me super cmim 1.530 €/m :
🔺Apartamenti 1 ka siperfaqe totale 106.53 m2 prej te cilave 87 m2 siperfaqe te brendshme neto dhe 19.53 m2 siperfaqe te perbashketa.
🪜Ndodhet ne katin e 5 ne objekt
Cmimi 163.000 €💥
🔺Apartamenti 2 ka siperfaqe totale 112.96 m2 prej te cilave 91.97 m2 siperfaqe te brendshme neto dhe 20.99 m2 siperfaqe te perbashketa.
🪜Ndodhet ne katin e 3 ne objekt
Cmimi 173.000 €💥
description_en: Splendor Residence is an ambitious project located in the Porcelan area, just a few meters from the main road. The interior space of the residential complex creates micro green spaces, basketball half-courts, children's playgrounds, 2 green flower gardens and recreational spaces around them. We have for sale a 2+1 apartment with a super price of €1,530/m: 🔺Apartment 1 has a total area of ​​106.53 m2, of which 87 m2 is a net internal area and 19.53 m2 is a shared area. 🪜Located on the 5th floor in the building Price €163,000💥 🔺Apartment 2 has a total area of ​​112.96 m2, of which 91.97 m2 is net internal area and 20.99 m2 is common area. 🪜Located on the 3rd floor in the building Price €173,000💥
